body: A cursory review, so I only flag minor issues. A deeper review is certainly warranted.

@dhower-qc, you should take a pass at this now.
(Is there a way to parameterize the interrupt files, instead of having 3 independent files? Like `interrupts[mode][interrupt_ID]`?)
Please be careful to not include extraneous files in your commits. Make the reviewers job as easy as possible. :wink:
Mostly nits, but there's a dependency on #958, and maybe some work needed in `sip.yaml`. Thanks for your efforts here!
